lines.text: Final from Green Bay: Falcons 35, Packers 14. Atlanta flew off with the cheese. Chuck?
Atlanta plowed that field row by row, Hal. Bijan Robinson ran like a mule smelling supper.
Plowed? They ran Green Bay over! That's grown-man football up front, Chuck.
Robinson had 29 carries, 194 yards, two touchdowns. Atlanta rushed for 242. Green Bay, 17.
Seventeen yards. You can't ask Jordan Love to throw 53 times and win.
He threw 53 times and lost by three scores! Quit protecting him.
Easy, fellas, no ruffled feathers. Dot, the turning point?
Late second quarter. Z. Harrison blocked a Packers field goal, then Austin Hooper caught a touchdown. Seventeen to seven.
That block was my favorite! Harrison got a paw on it!
Mine was Michael Penix Jr. hitting Drake London deep for 68. Found him like a horse finds the barn.
London finished with nine catches for 194 yards, matching Robinson's rushing total.
Leave it to Dot to find matching socks in a blowout.
My pick: the 92-yard, 6:18 third-quarter drive, finished by Brian Robinson Jr.
Right after Green Bay got stopped on downs. That's when the gate swung shut.
Moose, surely the defense gave you something else.
Cameron Thomas got a sack, and X. Watts picked Love late. Lights out!
Hold on. Love still threw for 312 and two scores. The boy kept swinging.
Green Bay held the ball 22:55. Atlanta, 37:05. Hard to swing from the bench, Chuck.
Player of the game, Dot. Make it official.
Bijan Robinson. His 55-yard run set up his first touchdown. His fantasy managers are grinning.
He ran through them like they owed him lunch money!
Fantasy fallout: London and Penix delivered. Love gave 312 and two scores, minus a pick. MarShawn Lloyd? Eleven yards.
Don't sleep on Matthew Golden: five catches, 100 yards, a touchdown.
The verdict, then: Atlanta ran, Green Bay couldn't. Chuck, last word?
Back in my day, you won running the ball. Atlanta did it the old way.
Your day? Chuck, your helmet was a leather cereal bowl!
For the record, Chuck's stories and Moose's jokes are both older than that helmet.
On that note, we'll pack it up, unlike Green Bay's run game. Goodnight from the GFFL.
